headline: Boston Dynamics is training its Atlas humanoid robot for factory work at a test centre built next to Hyundai's Georgia car plant.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: the centre opened in September and the original 8 Oct article could not be read, so there is no confirmed new event.
importance_line: Humanoid robots are still in practice rounds before they work on a real car line, so nothing about jobs changes yet; the timeline is Hyundai's plan, and the reports describe training rather than production work.
summary: Manufacturing Dive and economy.ac report that Boston Dynamics, owned by Hyundai, opened the Robotics Metaplant Application Center near Savannah, Georgia, in September 2026 and is training Atlas there, first on putting parts in assembly order, with machine tending and kit assembly planned next. Hyundai plans to put Atlas into real production from 2028 and to deploy 25,000 of the robots in its plants.
notes: Desk-built entry from economy.ac and Manufacturing Dive because the autoevolution original was blocked (HTTP 403).
